summary: You have named testimonials, WhatsApp and a clear commercial and private structure, but zero counters and mismatched contact details weaken trust.

findings.problem: Cases Won shows + 0 and Client Satisfaction shows % 0 while the text claims 500+ successful cases and a 98% satisfaction rate.
findings.cost: Zeros next to big claims make both look false.
findings.fix: Working counters with figures you can support.

findings.problem: The main line is +974 4474 2444 but the WhatsApp link goes to a different number, +974 6668 8222. The email uses lusaillawfirm.qa while the site is lusaillawfirm.com.
findings.cost: Clients are unsure which number and which email are real.
findings.fix: One checked set of contact details.

findings.problem: Sarah Al-Mansoori's testimonial nearly repeats Ahmed Al-Khalifa's. All three news posts show the same date, Feb 3, 2026, and the first excerpt repeats its title.
findings.cost: Repeated quotes and identical dates look like template content.
findings.fix: Real, varied testimonials and dated posts.

findings.problem: The mobile menu items Commercial and Private link to #. Consult Now repeats three times, there is no contact form, and no lawyers are named.
findings.cost: Clients want to know who will act for them and how to reach you.
findings.fix: Working menus, an enquiry form and lawyer profiles.

redesign: One checked phone, WhatsApp and email, with a short enquiry form.
Real testimonials, lawyer profiles and working menus.
